get_order_context.title: Get order context
get_order_context.description: Reads the current restaurant supplier-order review. Returns guide, store, serviceDate, cutoffAt, deliveryAt, forecast, draft, lines, focusedSkuId, pins, signals, previewId, and revision.

add_local_signal.title: Add local signal
add_local_signal.description: Stores one local booking, event cancellation, or operator note in revisioned local state without calculating or previewing the order. Handoff receipts are a separate record. Returns signalId, kind, label, revision, and previewBecameStale.

inputSchema.description: A local signal write tied to a specific review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

kind.description: Signal kind. Operator notes are operational facts in the order review.

label.description: Short human-authored label stored in the signals panel.

covers.description: Guest count for a booking signal.

occurredAt.description: Local date or time associated with the signal.

note.description: Human-authored detail stored with the signal.

create_order_preview.title: Create order preview
create_order_preview.description: Creates and renders a revisioned supplier-order preview from current signals and pins. The saved order and adoption status remain unchanged. Returns previewId, revision, covers and laborHours before and after, each line's before, after, delta, and reason, cost before and after, and warnings.

inputSchema.description: A supplier-order preview tied to a specific review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

rationale.description: Short reason stored with the preview.

adopt_order_preview.title: Adopt order preview
adopt_order_preview.description: Changes the working order to the active order preview after manager approval. This action is registered while a current preview is adoptable. The previewId and expectedRevision identify that state. Returns revision, adopted covers, laborHours, and cost, undoAvailable, and noExternalAction.

inputSchema.description: An adoption tied to the active preview and its review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

note.description: Human-facing note stored with the adoption.

save_handoff_receipt.title: Save handoff receipt
save_handoff_receipt.description: Stores a manager handoff summary as a local browser receipt. Operator notes are operational facts in the order review; handoff receipts are shift records. Returns receiptId, revision, and confirmation that the result stayed in this browser.

inputSchema.description: A local handoff receipt tied to a specific review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

managerSummary.description: Human-authored handoff summary stored in the local receipt.
